mapper.select:
select * from sec_contract_sign_please_review
and cspr_review_matter like concat('%',#{params.csprReviewMatter},'%')
and cspr_approval_unit like concat('%',#{params.csprApprovalUnit},'%')
and cspr_approval_content like concat('%',#{params.csprApprovalContent},'%')
and secId = #{params.secId}
and state = #{params.state}
and create_uname like concat('%',#{params.createUname},'%')

select sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Other_Valuation as secOtherValuation, sec.Sec_Pricing_Method as secPricingMethod, sec.Sec_Money as secMoney, scspr.* from sec_contract_sign_please_review scspr left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=scspr.Sec_Id where scspr.cspr_id = #{csprId}
